Firstly, IVP trades at a P/E ratio of 7.99x, significantly lower than the sector benchmark of 22.59x [E6]. This implies that investors are not fully recognizing the company's value or potential growth prospects compared to its peers. Secondly, IVP has a price-to-book ratio of 0.99x against a sector benchmark of 1.87x [E7], indicating that the stock is trading at a discount relative to book value and potentially undervalued by the market. Additionally, the company's fundamentals-led performance supports this under-appreciation. Over the past five years, IVP has shown compounded sales growth of 15% [E15], outperforming the sector median of 12.7% [E75]. Furthermore, recent profit growth has exceeded one-year price growth by 88%, suggesting that the company is starting to outperform expectations [E57].
